entities.summary: Elizabeth Clare Prophet was an American spiritual leader, author, and founder of the Church Universal and Triumphant, a New Age religious organization. At its peak, the church had an estimated 30 to 50 thousand followers. Her teachings blended elements of mysticism, Christianity, and Eastern religions, and she authored numerous books on spirituality, gaining prominence in New Age circles.
